text:
marta: handing off to @sam for tonight. Quick watchlist: encoder_pool_util flapping quietly in prod-kv-zone-2 and intermittent prefix-cache latency spikes on long-sequences. Not an incident yet but noisy.

sam: thanks — severity? any immediate mitigation I should know about?

marta: severity low, SLA unaffected. We suppressed pager for encoder_pool while rolling a small canary earlier. Symptoms look like GC pressure on a subset; a few model_init 500s correlated with spikes. Actions taken: increased pool on canary nodes, paused the broader rollout. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/encoder-pool (annotated).

lina: are you seeing 5xx counts go up or just p95/p99 latency?

marta: mostly p95/p99 on tokenizer/model_init paths. 5xx ~0.05% — borderline noise but worth watching.

oncall-bot: Alert: encoder_pool_util flapping on prod-kv-zone-2 — 4 triggers in last 20m. Paging suppressed (policy: noisy-alerts).

ryan: I'll shadow early part of the night. If you need a coverage swap ping me at 22:00 UTC.

sam: can someone paste the quick scale/restart commands? will keep them handy.

marta: commands: 
```
# scale encoder pool
kubectl -n runtime scale deploy encoder-pool --replicas=6
# trigger cache reload
curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/reload-cache
# tail logs for last 15m
./tools/stream-logs --svc encoder --since 15m
```

alex: FYI there's a low-risk batching config change scheduled at 03:00 UTC that we postponed earlier, but it might still slip. We've annotated it as 'hold if encoder flapping' in the deploy notes.

sam: noted — I'll add a canary gate and rollback tag. If encoder_pool keeps spiking hold the deploy.

lina: escalation plan: if flapping persists >30m or 5xx rises above 0.5% escalate to eng-runtime and run the pool restart script (runbook step 4). I'll be on standby.

marta: added watchlist note to handoff doc and flagged the runbook with current timestamps. :thumbsup:

sam: also noticed prefix-cache miss rate ticked up after the reranker A/B test. If misses >15% route reranker traffic to fallback v1 (console toggle: routing.reranker -> v1).

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: previous_oncall=marta, next_oncall=sam, watchlist=[encoder_pool, prefix_cache, reranker_abtest].

sam: thanks all. I'm primary oncall until 08:00 local. Ping here or DM for quick swaps. I'll log the coverage swap in the calendar.

ryan: :eyes: I'll take the 00:00-02:00 UTC check-ins and run a quick health sweep at 00:30.

marta: cheers — will follow up in the morning with traces and a short post-handoff note if anything changes.
